scenario: Account holder adds an authorised user and mentions a child on the account.
notes: PII belonging to people who are not the caller. A pipeline that anchors on the verified account holder can miss third-party names entirely.

I can add her as an authorised user. Does she need her own login?
Yes, send it to elena.petrova@example.net. Also my son Tomas is 14, he uses the tablet line.
